content.productDescription:
Hang these three charming New York autumn wall art prints as your pictures above fireplace and instantly bring that cosy, golden-season feeling into your living room. Each print captures a different side of the Big Apple in autumn — a classic Manhattan brownstone flanked by ochre trees, a corner coffee shop with leaves drifting past its dark green frontage, and the iconic NYC skyline rising above a canopy of warm autumn colour — all rendered in a loose, painterly illustration style with a soft white background, warm grey tones and rich ochre-yellow throughout. It's New York the way we all dream of experiencing it: unhurried, beautiful and just a little cinematic.

What I really love about this set is how well the palette travels. The white, grey and ochre combination is warm without being loud, and the illustrated style feels personal rather than corporate — more like a postcard from someone who genuinely loves the city than a generic travel print. Whether you're a New York fan, a travel lover, or simply after something with character and warmth, this trio does the job beautifully.

What's Included with Pictures Above Fireplace New York Autumn Wall Art Prints | "Autumn in New York" White Grey Ochre | Set of 3

  • A set of 3 individual art prints featuring watercolour-style autumn New York illustrations in white, grey and ochre tones
  • Printed in the UK using fade-resistant pigment inks for long-lasting colour — suitable for indoor use
  • The framed and canvas-wrapped options arrive ready to hang straight out of the box, saving you the hassle of hunting for frames that fit
  • Choose between unframed and framed options in multiple sizes and in Luster or Museum quality; also available in wrapped canvas size options

How to Style Pictures Above Fireplace with This New York Autumn Set

I'd hang all three prints in a row, evenly spaced, centred above the fireplace breast — it's the classic approach and it works every single time. Aim to keep the bottom of the prints roughly 15–20 cm above the mantelpiece so they feel connected to the fireplace rather than floating. If your mantel already has objects on it, like candles, a clock or some greenery, keep the arrangement simple and let the art do the talking. The ochre tones in the prints pick up beautifully on warm wood tones, terracotta accents or even a mustard cushion on a nearby sofa.

These prints also suit a slightly asymmetric arrangement if you'd prefer something less formal — try hanging the central coffee shop print a touch lower than the outer two for a relaxed, gallery-wall feel. The neutral white backgrounds mean they'll sit happily against warm white, linen, sage or even a deeper charcoal wall. For more inspiration on styling travel art in your home, have a browse through our travel wall art collection — there are plenty of ideas in there.

Choosing the Right Size and Finish for Your Fireplace Wall

The size of your fireplace wall really does matter here. As a rough guide, the total width of the three prints together should be somewhere between half and two-thirds of the width of your fireplace or chimney breast — any wider and they'll feel cramped against the wall edges; any smaller and they may look a little lost. If you have a generous, wide chimney breast, go for one of the larger size options so the set fills the space with confidence. For a narrower or more modest fireplace, the mid-range sizes tend to look just right.

In terms of finish, the Luster paper gives you a gently sheen that makes the ochre tones really sing — brilliant in rooms with good natural light. Museum quality paper has a matt, fine-art feel that works wonderfully in cosier, warmer-lit spaces. If you'd like something with more texture and depth, the wrapped canvas option gives the set a more contemporary, gallery feel. Scroll down to see how each size looks above a fireplace before you decide — there's a size-guide image below showing every option in the room so you can picture it properly.

aiItems.content:
What are pictures above fireplace?

Pictures above fireplace are wall art prints hung directly above a fireplace or chimney breast, typically as a focal point for the room. They can be a single large print, a symmetrical pair, or a set of three or more arranged in a row or gallery-style grouping. The space above a fireplace is one of the most-viewed spots in a living room or dining room, making it the ideal place to display art that reflects your personality and pulls the whole room together. Choosing a set of three prints — like this New York autumn trio — is a popular approach because the trio format fills a wide chimney breast naturally while keeping the look cohesive and balanced.

How to Hang Pictures Above Fireplace: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide

1. Measure your wall space: Measure the width of your chimney breast or fireplace wall. Aim for your set of three prints to span roughly half to two-thirds of that width — this keeps things balanced and avoids the art looking too small or too crowded.

2. Mark the centre point: Find the horizontal centre of your fireplace and use a light pencil mark or a piece of masking tape on the wall to mark it. Your central print should be centred on this point.

3. Decide on height: The bottom edge of your prints should sit around 15–20 cm above the mantelpiece. If you have a tall chimney breast with no mantel, position the centre of the prints at roughly eye level when standing.

4. Lay the prints out on the floor first: Before putting any nails in the wall, lay all three prints on the floor in front of the fireplace and step back to check the spacing and arrangement. Equal gaps between each print (around 4–6 cm) tends to look the neatest.

5. Use a spirit level: Once you're happy with the layout, use a spirit level when hanging each print to make sure they're all perfectly straight and aligned with each other.

6. Stand back and enjoy: Give them a final check from across the room — adjusting by even a centimetre or two can make a real difference to how polished the finished result looks.

Choosing Your Format: Unframed, Framed or Wrapped Canvas?

Unframed Print — The print is shipped rolled or flat, ready for you to frame yourself. Great if you already have a favourite frame style or want to match existing frames on your wall. Available in Luster art paper or Museum quality paper.

Framed Print — Arrives fully assembled and ready to hang straight out of the box — no extra shopping required. The framed option is ideal if you want a polished, finished look above your fireplace without any hassle. Available in Luster art paper or Museum quality paper, in multiple sizes.

Wrapped Canvas — The artwork is printed on canvas and wrapped around a wooden stretcher frame, giving a contemporary gallery feel with depth and texture. No glass, no frame needed — just hang and enjoy. Available in a range of sizes and arrives ready to hang.

Paper finish: Luster — A semi-sheen surface that makes colours appear vivid and warm — a great choice if your room gets good natural light or you want the ochre tones in this New York set to really stand out.

Paper finish: Museum Quality — A smooth, matt fine-art surface with a softer, more understated look. Perfect for cosier rooms or if you prefer a gallery-style, non-reflective finish.
